title: 第三十二章 梵脉现世骨血旧烙印第三十一章 暮风锁台清梵镇蛟铃
lines: 狂风卷暮，擂台上碎风呼啸。
一道细碎裂纹横贯青铜镇蛟铃身，错位铃舌卡死缝隙，原本清越镇缚血脉的铃音彻底断绝，只剩零碎沙哑颤音消散晚风之中。
封禁溃散，桎梏全无。
淡青鎏金鳞纹顺着沈砚小臂肌理蔓延攀升，鳞甲细密剔透，纹路流转上古水系灵光，每一片鳞甲边缘都泛着克制邪力的莹润光泽，域外煞气、清心梵力触之便会消融瓦解。
方才被梵剑气割裂的皮肉伤口，在蛟脉本源自愈力催动下飞速结痂收口，渗入经脉的纯白梵力，被鳞光自主剥离逼出体外，化作点点白光散落青石地面。
周身滞涩尽数褪去，丹田灵力全速流转，碎云诀周天运转毫无阻滞。
这才是沈砚完整战力。
台下全场死寂落针可闻，几秒后，炸裂哗然轰然掀翻整片看台！
“碎了！清风宗三阶灵宝清梵镇蛟铃，被武徒三重的沈砚一指击碎！”
“以身承百道剑伤，舍弃身法游走，贴身搏命找灵宝弱点，这心性、胆识，同辈绝无仅有！”
“之前都说蛟脉是沈砚底气，如今看来，他骨子里的韧劲，远比血脉更加可怕！”
看台议论疯涌而起，风向彻底逆转。
此前所有人都笃定沈砚必败，灵宝克血脉、功法克灵力、身份压出身，三重死局无解，可这名青衫少年，硬生生以血肉之躯，破开宿命克制。
侯府席位，阿禾攥紧的手掌骤然松开，掌心满是冷汗，眼眶微微泛红，低声喃喃：“公子做到了……”
执法长老秦守紧绷半日的脊背缓缓放松，眼底满是动容，沉声感慨：“不恃血脉天赋，不倚身法捷径，绝境敢舍命破局，此子武道本心，远超郡城所有天骄。”
贵宾席上，周清鸢眉眼舒展，悬着的心彻底落地，玉指轻捻剑柄，眸底亮色愈发深重。她修习观气术阅人无数，却从未见过这般逆境不破防、顺境不张狂的武者，沈砚的隐忍，从不是懦弱，而是蓄力待发。
唯独清风宗席位，全场长老面色铁青，周身梵力躁动不稳。
镇蛟铃乃是宗门传承至宝，历经三代宗主温养淬炼，坚硬堪比下品法器，今日竟被一介边城武徒击碎，不仅折损宗门颜面，更是断掉宗门后续抢夺陨蛟秘境的核心依仗。
擂台正中，楚凌怔怔低头，看向腰间开裂古铃，温润眼底第一次涌上极致错愕，继而翻涌难以压制的戾气。
他奉命出手，背负宗门千人安危，手握克制底牌，本该稳妥拿下战局，废掉沈砚蛟脉，可到头来，底牌破碎，战局倾覆。
“你怎么会找到铃舌衔接处？”楚凌抬眸，嗓音不复此前淡然，带着难以置信的沙哑，“此为灵宝内隐弱点，除却历代清风宗宗主，外人无从知晓。”
从古遗迹出土之初，镇蛟铃弱点便被宗门封存秘典，绝不外泄，沈砚一介边城子弟，绝无可能知晓秘辛。
沈砚抬眸，鎏金鳞光映着清冷眉眼，缓缓开口：“铃音震血脉之时，灵力流转失衡，铃身气息断层，破绽自现。”
并非知晓秘辛，而是对战之时极致观气，捕捉灵宝灵力流转破绽。
自小在西落院受尽磋磨，他早已练就入微洞察力，交手之间，可观灵力轨迹、辨招式虚实、察器物弱点，这是五年挨打求生，练出来的本能。
“单凭观气，破我宗门传承灵宝……”楚凌胸腔气血翻涌，心底自尊彻底碎裂，原本奉命出手的漠然尽数消散，取而代之的是天骄落败的不甘，“我不服。”
话音落下一瞬，楚凌周身纯白梵力骤然暴涨，远超此前数倍，衣袂无风自动，眉心浮现一道淡金色细小梵纹，扎根皮肉，熠熠生辉。
精纯厚重、带着古老神性的梵息席卷整片擂台，风压推开暮风，压得擂台边角旗帜尽数弯折。
台下懂行长老瞬间失声惊呼：“先天梵脉！楚凌觉醒了宗门先天梵脉！”
“清风宗失传百年先天体质，专门镇压上古妖族血脉，比镇蛟铃克制之力更强！”
新伏笔骤然落地，战局二度反转！
沈砚眸色微凝，眼底掠过一丝警惕。
此前交手，楚凌始终收敛体质力量，只用普通梵力对战，藏拙至此刻，底牌彻底掀开。先天梵脉，天生本源克制蛟兽血脉，层级压制，远超灵宝外力。
高楼雅间，原本暴怒失态的夜衍，瞬间敛去戾气，紫眸亮起玩味暗光，唇角勾起阴冷笑意。
他非但不恼，反倒悠然倚靠栏杆，轻声低语：“原来楚凌藏了梵脉底牌，倒是省去我动手。先天梵克蛟脉，天定相克，这一战，更有意思了。”
身旁黑衣属下躬身低语：“阁主，先天梵脉可重创蛟本源，是否催动地底残余煞阵，配合楚凌围杀沈砚？”
“不必。”夜衍指尖摩挲蛟骨手串，手串献祭符文微微发烫，暗藏隐秘伏笔，“我要看看，剥离外力、阵法、灵宝加持，纯体质对决之下，这碧鳞蛟脉，究竟能走到哪一步。另外，盯紧沈砚骨血波动，记录他血脉觉醒时的烙印纹路，传回冥阁总部。”
一语暗藏天大悬念：冥阁总部远非永安郡分支，夜衍抓捕沈砚，不止为秘境献祭，更是要采集蛟脉烙印，上交上级！
属下闻声低头，眼底敬畏更深，无人知晓，永安郡冥阁分支，不过总部抛下的一枚外围棋子。
擂台之上，眉心梵纹发亮的楚凌，气质彻底蜕变。
温润褪去，神性凛然，周身梵力化作实质白芒，包裹素色梵剑，剑身纹路逐一亮起，剑息厚重庄严，自带净化万物之力。
“我本不想动用梵脉，此力杀生过重。”楚凌握剑抬手，气息稳步攀升，半步触及武师门槛，“但宗门千人性命系于我身，今日，必须镇你蛟脉。”
先天梵脉加持，武徒三重巅峰战力，直逼半步武师。
相较于借助阵法、灵宝取胜，觉醒体质正面搏杀，才是楚凌真正底气。
content_en:
A strong wind swept through the dusk, and the breaking wind howled on the stage.
A thin crack ran across the body of the bronze dragon-suppressing bell, and the tongue of the misplaced bell stuck in the gap. The original sound of the bell that suppressed the blood of Qingyue was completely cut off, leaving only fragments of hoarse and vibrating sounds dissipated in the evening wind.
The ban collapsed, and all the shackles were gone.
The pale green gilt scales spread along the texture of Shen Yan's forearm. The scales are fine and clear, and the lines are filled with ancient water aura. The edges of each scale are glowing with a lustrous luster that restrains evil forces. The evil spirits from outside the territory and the pure Brahma energy will melt and disintegrate when touched.
The flesh wound that had just been cut by the Brahma Sword Qi quickly scabbed and closed under the stimulation of the original healing power of the Jiao Veins. The pure white Brahma power that penetrated the meridians was peeled off by the scale light and forced out of the body, turning into dots of white light and scattering on the bluestone ground.
All the stagnation all over the body has faded away, the spiritual energy in the Dantian is flowing at full speed, and the Shattering Cloud Art moves around the sky without any hindrance.
This is Shen Yan's complete combat power.
There was a dead silence in the audience, and a few seconds later, an explosion shook the entire stands!
"It's broken! The Qingfeng Sect's third-level spiritual treasure Qingfanzhen Jiaoling was shattered by the finger of Shen Yan, a third-level martial artist!"
"To bear hundreds of sword wounds with one's body, to abandon one's body skills and wander around, to fight for one's life to find the weakness of a spiritual treasure, this kind of character and courage are unique among my peers!"
"It was said before that Jiao Vein was Shen Yan's confidence, but now it seems that the tenacity in his bones is far more terrifying than his blood!"
Discussions in the stands went crazy, and the direction of the wind completely reversed.
Previously, everyone was sure that Shen Yan would be defeated. Lingbao defeated his bloodline, his martial arts defeated his spiritual power, and his identity suppressed his origin. There was no solution to the triple deadlock. However, this young man in green shirt used his flesh and blood to break through the restraint of fate.
In the seat of the Marquis Mansion, Ah He's clenched palms suddenly loosened up. His palms were covered with cold sweat, his eyes were slightly red, and he murmured in a low voice: "Young master did it..."
Law enforcement elder Qin Shou's back, which had been tense for a long time, slowly relaxed. His eyes were filled with emotion, and he sighed in a deep voice: "He does not rely on his bloodline talent, does not rely on shortcuts, and dares to risk his life to break the situation in desperate situations. This child's martial arts heart is far beyond all the geniuses in the county."
At the VIP table, Zhou Qingyuan's eyebrows relaxed, her hanging heart completely fell to the ground, her jade fingers lightly twisted the hilt of the sword, and the light in her eyes became darker and darker. She has practiced the Qi Observation Technique and has seen countless people, but she has never seen such a warrior who does not break his defense in adversity and is not arrogant in good times. Shen Yan's forbearance is never cowardly, but he is ready to attack.
Only in the Qingfeng Sect seat, all the elders in the room looked livid, and the Brahma energy around them was restless.
The Suppressing Jiao Bell is the sect's most treasured treasure. It has been warmed and tempered by three generations of sect masters. It is as hard as a low-grade magic weapon. Today, it was shattered by a warrior from a border city. It not only damaged the sect's face, but also cut off the sect's core support for the subsequent robbery of the Fallen Jiao Secret Realm.
In the middle of the ring, Chu Ling lowered his head in confusion and looked at the cracked ancient bell on his waist. For the first time, extreme astonishment filled his warm eyes, followed by uncontrollable anger.
He was ordered to take action, with the safety of thousands of people in the sect on his back. He held the trump card of restraint. He should have won the battle safely and eliminated Shen Yanjiao's veins, but in the end, the trump card was shattered and the battle situation was overturned.
"How did you find the connection between the bell and the tongue?" Chu Ling raised his eyes, and his voice was no longer calm as before, with an unbelievable hoarseness, "This is the hidden weakness of Lingbao, and no outsider knows about it except for the previous generations of Qingfeng Sect masters."
From the time the ancient ruins were unearthed, Zhen Jiao Ling's weak point has been sealed in the secret book by the sect and will never be leaked. Shen Yan, a kid from a border town, has no chance of knowing the secret.
Shen Yan raised his eyes, his cold brows reflecting the light of his gilded scales, and he slowly said: "When the sound of the bell shakes the blood, the flow of spiritual power becomes unbalanced, the aura of the bell body is broken, and flaws appear on their own."
It's not about knowing the secrets, but about observing the Qi extremely during the battle and catching the flaws in the flow of spiritual power of the Lingbao.
Having been trained and trained in Xiluoyuan since he was a child, he has already developed subtle insights. During a fight, he can observe the trajectory of spiritual energy, distinguish the true and false of moves, and detect the weaknesses of equipment. This is an instinct he has developed after five years of being beaten to survive.
"You can destroy the spiritual treasure inherited by my sect just by watching Qi..." Chu Ling's chest surged with energy and blood, and the self-esteem in his heart was completely shattered. The indifference that was originally ordered to take action disappeared, and was replaced by the unwillingness of the genius to lose, "I don't accept it."
The moment the words fell, the pure white Brahma energy around Chu Ling suddenly surged, far exceeding the previous several times. His clothes moved automatically without wind, and a small pale golden Brahma pattern appeared between his eyebrows, taking root in his skin and shining brightly.
Buzz—!
The pure and thick Brahma breath with ancient divinity swept across the entire arena. The wind pressure pushed away the evening wind and bent all the flags at the corners of the arena.
The knowledgeable elders in the audience suddenly exclaimed: "Innate Brahma Vein! Chu Ling has awakened the sect's innate Brahma Vein!"
"The Qingfeng Sect's innate physique has been lost for hundreds of years. It specializes in suppressing the bloodline of the ancient demon clan. It is more powerful than the Suppressing Jiao Ling!"
A new foreshadowing suddenly came to light, and the battle situation reversed for the second time!
Shen Yan's eyes were slightly focused, and a trace of vigilance flashed across his eyes.
In the previous fights, Chu Ling had always restrained his physical strength and only used ordinary Brahma energy to fight. He had hidden his clumsiness until now, and his trump card was completely revealed. The innate Brahma vein, the innate source of restraint of the dragon beast bloodline, the level of suppression, far exceeds the external force of the spiritual treasure.
In the elegant room of the high-rise building, Ye Yan, who was originally furious and lost his temper, instantly suppressed his anger, his purple eyes lit up with a playful look at the dark light, and the corners of his lips curled into a sinister smile.
Instead of being annoyed, he leaned leisurely on the railing and whispered softly: "It turns out that Chu Ling has hidden the trump card of the Brahma Vein, so it saves me the trouble of doing it. The innate Brahma Vein overcomes the Jiao Vein, and the Heavenly Destiny overcomes each other. This battle is more interesting."
The black-clothed subordinate beside him bowed and whispered: "Pavilion Master, the innate Brahma vein can severely damage the source of the dragon. Do you want to activate the remaining evil formation underground to cooperate with Chu Ling to surround Shen Yan?"
"No need." Ye Yan rubbed the dragon bone bracelet with his fingertips. The sacrificial runes on the bracelet were slightly hot, hiding a secret foreshadowing. "I want to see how far this green scale dragon vein can go, stripped of external forces, formations, spiritual treasure blessings, and a pure physical duel. In addition, keep an eye on the blood fluctuations of Shen Yan's bones, record the imprint patterns when his bloodline awakens, and send it back to the Ming Pavilion headquarters."
One sentence hides a huge suspense: the Ming Pavilion headquarters is far from a branch of Yong'an County. Ye Yan captured Shen Yan not only to sacrifice for the secret realm, but also to collect the dragon vein brand and hand it over to his superiors!
The subordinates bowed their heads after hearing the sound, their eyes deepened in awe. No one knew that the Ming Pavilion branch of Yong'an County was just a peripheral chess piece left behind by the headquarters.
On the stage, Chu Ling, with the Sanskrit lines between his eyebrows shining brightly, had a completely transformed temperament.
The warmth faded away, the divinity became awe-inspiring, and the Brahma energy all over the body turned into a substantial white light, wrapping the plain-colored Brahma sword. The lines on the sword body lit up one by one. The sword breath was thick and solemn, and it had the power to purify all things.
"I didn't want to use the Brahma Vein. This power is too heavy to kill." Chu Ling held the sword and raised his hand, his aura steadily rising, touching the martial arts threshold halfway, "But the lives of thousands of people in the sect are tied to me. Today, I must suppress your Jiao Vein."
Blessed by the innate Brahma veins, the martial arts disciple's third-level peak combat power is almost as strong as that of a half-step martial artist.
Rather than relying on formations and spiritual treasures to win, awakening one's physique and fighting head-on is Chu Ling's true confidence.
title_en: Chapter 32: The old imprint of the Brahma Vein's flesh and blood in this world Chapter 31: Mufeng Locking Platform, Qingfan Town Jiaoling
